summary: Replaced the missing Supabase CLI fallback with a shared build-time Management API reader. It obtains operator auth at the query point, sends one fixed SELECT with read_only=true, accepts only HTTP 201 with a top-level row array, validates every row, and reports sanitized failures. All three catalog/ledger callers now await that reader.

verification.check: source inspection of shared helper and all callers
verification.result: No CLI invocation remains; fixed SELECT queries flow through one async authenticated read; strict drift and migration checks retain their fail-closed branches.
Added fetch-boundary tests for distinct rows, read_only request, second-statement refusal, sanitized 403, and malformed-row refusal; execution is reserved for root's guarded run.

limitations: No tests, compile, build, SQL, or release were run by this worker under the active single-heavy-job lease.
The operator token is read only from process configuration or sibling aidream/.env; its value is never copied into extension env files or emitted in error messages.
Live strict gate result and independent peer review are pending; EXT-D-0004 remains in-fix.
next_action: After the UI resource lease ends, root runs the focused helper test, compile, and real strict release candidate under the guard, then obtains fresh source peer review.
